headline.en: Blue Owl Finance prices $750 million 6.750% senior notes due 2036
headline.zh: Blue Owl Finance 定价 7.5 亿美元、票面 6.750%、2036 年到期的优先票据

summary.en: Blue Owl Finance LLC, an indirect subsidiary of Blue Owl Capital Inc., is offering $750 million of 6.750% senior notes due 2036. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Blue Owl Capital Inc. and a list of affiliated entities, with interest payable February 18 and August 18 starting February 18, 2027.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Capital Inc. 的间接子公司 Blue Owl Finance LLC 发行 7.5 亿美元、票面利率 6.750%、2036 年到期的优先票据。该票据由 Blue Owl Capital Inc. 及一系列关联实体提供全额无条件担保，利息自 2027 年 2 月 18 日起每年 2 月 18 日和 8 月 18 日支付。

headline.en: Managers Build 401(k) Teams a Year After Alternatives Order
headline.zh: 另类资产行政令一年后，管理机构组建401(k)团队

summary.en: A year after an executive order allowed alternatives into 401(k) retirement accounts, managers have set up defined contribution teams, formed partnerships and launched new funds. Barriers still block the $14tn opportunity, and private credit managers have been among those positioning for it.
summary.zh: 在允许另类资产进入401(k)退休账户的行政令发布一年后，管理机构已设立固定缴款团队、建立合作并推出新基金。障碍仍阻碍着这一14万亿美元的机会，私募信贷管理机构也在为此布局。

headline.en: Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF reaches $30bn in assets
headline.zh: Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF 资产规模达 300 亿美元

summary.en: Janus Henderson Investors' AAA CLO ETF has reached $30bn in assets under management. The Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF (JAAA) has also attracted $5.7bn in year-to-date inflows, as investors increasingly look to CLO ETFs amid this year's rate environment.
summary.zh: Janus Henderson Investors 的 AAA CLO ETF 资产管理规模已达 300 亿美元。Janus Henderson AAA CLO ETF（JAAA）今年迄今还吸引了 57 亿美元流入，因投资者在今年利率环境下日益关注 CLO ETF。
